text:
---
name: wb-chat
description: "Route Workbench intake with deterministic priority, bounded conversation/task context, local confidence gates, active-owner and pending-handoff continuity, and cx-adv semantic fallback. Directly answers lightweight chat/Q&A and hands research, design, repository analysis, execution, Git, session, learning, and finalization to one canonical owner."
metadata:
  short-description: "上下文连续的 Workbench 智能路由与轻量问答"
  category: public
---

# wb-chat Skill

## 概览

`wb-chat` 是 Workbench 的智能入口和轻量问答 owner，不是所有请求的必经模型层。rules、显式 `$skill` 或 `apps/agent/conf/skill-routing.yaml` 中全局唯一的完整短语优先；其余输入由本 skill 检索有界上下文，先做保守的本地语义评分，再按需通过 `wb-chat.semantic_routing` 调用 `cx-adv`。

`wb-chat` 可以承接日常对话、简单问答、互动澄清和任务入口规划，但不冒充领域 owner 执行工作。仓库分析、需求设计、任务执行、学习、资料研究、Git、session 和收尾仍转交对应 skill。

## 触发条件

- 闲聊、路径/状态说明和不需要读取重型证据的简单解释。
- 没有完整命中确定性短语，需要判断主 owner。
- 输入包含多个意图、多个显式 skill，或继续处理会产生 owner 歧义；同一 project 有明确规划 owner 时由本 skill 选择主入口，不要求用户理解 skill 拆分。
- 用户用“继续”“按这个来”“按照方案落地”等表达延续或确认，需要恢复 `active_owner` 或 `pending_handoff`。
- 领域 skill 发现请求命中自身反触发条件后，交回本入口重新路由。

## 不触发条件

- 只有一个显式 `$skill`：先直达该 skill，由它执行边界自检。
- 完整输入命中 `apps/agent/conf/skill-routing.yaml` 的唯一短语：直接到映射 owner，不额外请求路由模型。
- 已经明确进入某个领域 owner 的连续任务：由连续性 fast lane 保持 owner；从评估/设计切换到实现仍需重新路由和授权检查。

## 路由优先级

1. 上游 `rules` 与 project skill surface 的稳定约束。
2. 单个已注册显式 `$skill`。`$HOME`、`$PATH` 等未注册 shell 变量不参与 skill 竞争。
3. 对输入做 Unicode NFKC、大小写、空白和句末标点归一化后，匹配全局唯一完整短语。
4. 恢复最近路由 envelope 中的 `active_owner`、`pending_handoff` 与 `interaction_mode`；只在当前输入明确延续或满足 gate 时直达。
5. 本地语义分析输出 score、runner-up 和 margin；同时通过 scope、上下文完整性、授权和风险门禁才接受。
6. 复杂或低置信输入先判断是否需要追问；仍可判定时用独立 Prompt 调用 `wb-chat.semantic_routing(cx-adv)`。
7. 模型结果再次通过相同门禁；失败、超时、无效 JSON 或候选接近时回到 `wb-chat mode=clarify|triage`。

仅子串命中不属于确定性直达。输入长度不是直达条件；短句也可能歧义，长句也不因包含关键词而强制直达。

确定性入口：

```bash
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent skills route --text '看下当前项目实现了什么功能'
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent skills route --project guanlan --text '调研这只股票'
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent skills route --check
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent.chat_router --text '继续' --no-model
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent.chat_router --text '帮我分析并修复这个问题' --print-prompt
```

## chat_mode

- `answer`：直接回答轻量问题，不落盘。
- `triage`：从 `rules/routing-policy.md` 选择一个 canonical owner。
- `clarify`：owner、scope 或授权会随答案变化时只问一个关键问题，并可写入 `pending_handoff`。

## 核心边界

- “当前项目实现了什么功能/服务、怎么使用” -> `wb-repo mode=context workflow=understand`。
- 同一 project 内用户先要计划、执行顺序或任务拆解，且某个已加载领域 skill 明确负责规划和下游交接 -> 路由该规划 owner；跨 project、owner 并列或授权不清才追问。
- 快速结构/入口速览 -> `wb-repo mode=context workflow=summary`。
- 已知路径的文档读取或代码解释 -> `wb-repo mode=context workflow=read-doc|explain-code`。
- 未知位置的本地事实、KB/索引检索 -> `wb-knowledge mode=search`。
- bug、失败、异常、根因、质量风险或健康扫描 -> `wb-repo mode=diagnose|health`。
- 修改、修复和验证 -> `wb-work mode=implement|repair|validate`；session/tmux/profile/daemon 运维 -> `wb-session`。
- Git -> `wb-git`；外部当前证据 -> `wb-research`；设计契约 -> `wb-design`。
- `wb-model` 只供其它 skill 分发模型 profile，不作为业务意图 owner。
- 任务规划先判断主要交付物：需求/架构契约归 `wb-design`，已确认实施归 `wb-work`；`wb-chat` 只负责入口分流和必要追问。
- 自我进化学习归 `wb-learning`；单次即时调整不自动晋升长期资产。

完整映射见 `rules/routing-policy.md` 和 `references/workbench-skill-map.md`。`interaction_mode` 只控制授权边界，不替代 owner。

## 引用路由

- canonical 任务映射：`rules/routing-policy.md`。
- 授权模式：`references/interaction-mode-policy.md`。
- 语义评分、上下文、连续性和接受门禁：`references/semantic-routing-contract.md`。
- skill 职责表：`references/workbench-skill-map.md`。
- 静态一致性用例：`references/routing-regression-cases.json`。
- owner 命中率评测集：`references/routing-evaluation-cases.json`。
- 确定性短语事实源：`apps/agent/conf/skill-routing.yaml`。

## 执行流程

1. `resolve`：检查上游 rules、project scope、显式 skill 和 exact phrase；已直达则停止。
2. `context`：读取当前输入、最近路由状态、最多若干条会话消息和同项目近期 TaskRecord 的预期、路由、结果、反馈与 learning 摘要；按配置脱敏、截断，不读取 TaskRecord 原始输入。
3. `continue`：验证 `active_owner` 或 `pending_handoff` 是否能在当前授权和风险门禁下延续。
4. `self-score`：识别轻量回答、复杂度、owner 候选、score 和 margin；高置信安全候选直接接受。
5. `model-route`：复杂或低置信输入用 `prompts/semantic-routing.md` 构造自包含 Prompt，经 `wb-model` 执行 `wb-chat.semantic_routing`。
6. `review`：验证 JSON schema、唯一 owner、加载面、上下文完整性、interaction mode、高风险当前轮证据与阈值。
7. `result`：返回轻量回答、唯一转交或一个关键追问，不执行目标 skill 的工作。

## 输出契约

- 输出：`chat_mode`、简短回答，或唯一 owner/mode/workflow 转交；路由 envelope 携带当前 decision、目标 owner、`router_source`、`match_type`、`confidence`、`margin`、`active_owner`、`pending_handoff`、`interaction_mode` 和一个 `clarification_question`。
- 实质任务进入收尾时，将路由 envelope 连同用户原文交给 `wb-finalize --routed-input`；它是路由证据，不是 `wb-chat` execution step。
- 不输出：仓库综合报告、evidence pack、正式设计、代码补丁、Git 写入或 session 操作。
- 成功标准：确定性命中不额外过模型；兜底分流没有 owner 冲突。

## 安全边界

默认只读，不保存或复制 Provider transcript，不把代码/diff 写入路由上下文；消息进入路由 Prompt 前做确定性凭据脱敏。高风险 owner 必须在当前输入中有明确证据，不能只凭旧状态、相似度或通用“继续”直达。

## 验证

修改本 skill 或路由映射后运行：

```bash
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent skills route --check
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent skills routing-regression
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent skills evaluate
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent.skill_execution resolve \
  --stage wb-chat.semantic_routing \
  --json
# 完整 95% gate：用与生产一致的 cx-adv profile 生成/capture semantic predictions，再执行：
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent skills evaluate --print-semantic-prompt \
  | bash <wb-model-skill-dir>/scripts/run.sh --stage wb-chat.routing_evaluation \
  > <captured.json>
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent skills evaluate --predictions <captured.json> --require-semantic
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent.skill_execution resolve \
  --stage wb-chat.routing_evaluation \
  --json
```

- `wb-chat.semantic_routing`：生产语义路由，共享层使用 `cx-adv` 且不做 profile fallback；本机层可通过 `configs/local/skills-execution.yaml` 覆盖。
- `wb-chat.routing_evaluation`：离线标注集评测，共享层使用与生产一致的 `cx-adv`；本机层可覆盖，但不参与生产请求路由。

两者的业务语义和输入输出归本 skill；执行映射只登记在 `configs/skills-execution.yaml`，`wb-model` 在调用 sn-cli 前拒绝未登记 ID。

## 完成标准

最终回复说明 `chat_mode`，或唯一转交的 owner/mode/workflow；直达必须留下可审计 score/margin/source，澄清必须只有一个关键问题。没有查证的事实不得写成已确认结论。

5. `model-route`：复杂或低置信输入用 `prompts/semantic-routing.md` 构造自包含 Prompt，经 `wb-model` 执行 `wb-chat.semantic_routing`。
6. `review`：验证 JSON schema、唯一 owner、加载面、上下文完整性、interaction mode、高风险当前轮证据与阈值。
7. `result`：返回轻量回答、唯一转交或一个关键追问，不执行目标 skill 的工作。

## 输出契约

- 输出：`chat_mode`、简短回答，或唯一 owner/mode/workflow 转交；路由 envelope 携带当前 decision、目标 owner、`router_source`、`match_type`、`confidence`、`margin`、`active_owner`、`pending_handoff`、`interaction_mode` 和一个 `clarification_question`。
- 实质任务进入收尾时，将路由 envelope 连同用户原文交给 `wb-finalize --routed-input`；它是路由证据，不是 `wb-chat` execution step。
- 不输出：仓库综合报告、evidence pack、正式设计、代码补丁、Git 写入或 session 操作。
- 成功标准：确定性命中不额外过模型；兜底分流没有 owner 冲突。

## 安全边界

默认只读，不保存或复制 Provider transcript，不把代码/diff 写入路由上下文；消息进入路由 Prompt 前做确定性凭据脱敏。高风险 owner 必须在当前输入中有明确证据，不能只凭旧状态、相似度或通用“继续”直达。

## 验证

修改本 skill 或路由映射后运行：

```bash
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent skills route --check
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent skills routing-regression
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent skills evaluate
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent.skill_execution resolve \
  --stage wb-chat.semantic_routing \
  --json
# 完整 95% gate：用与生产一致的 cx-adv profile 生成/capture semantic predictions，再执行：
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent skills evaluate --print-semantic-prompt \
  | bash <wb-model-skill-dir>/scripts/run.sh --stage wb-chat.routing_evaluation \
  > <captured.json>
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent skills evaluate --predictions <captured.json> --require-semantic
scripts/agent-run python -m wb.agent.skill_execution resolve \
  --stage wb-chat.routing_evaluation \
  --json
```

- `wb-chat.semantic_routing`：生产语义路由，共享层使用 `cx-adv` 且不做 profile fallback；本机层可通过 `configs/local/skills-execution.yaml` 覆盖。
- `wb-chat.routing_evaluation`：离线标注集评测，共享层使用与生产一致的 `cx-adv`；本机层可覆盖，但不参与生产请求路由。

两者的业务语义和输入输出归本 skill；执行映射只登记在 `configs/skills-execution.yaml`，`wb-model` 在调用 sn-cli 前拒绝未登记 ID。

## 完成标准

最终回复说明 `chat_mode`，或唯一转交的 owner/mode/workflow；直达必须留下可审计 score/margin/source，澄清必须只有一个关键问题。没有查证的事实不得写成已确认结论。

# wb-chat 语义路由契约

## 运行链路

`rules / project surface` -> `explicit $skill` -> `exact phrase` -> `active owner / pending handoff` -> `wb-chat self analysis` -> `wb-chat.semantic_routing(cx-adv)` -> `answer / direct / clarify`。

确定性层未命中后，`wb-chat` 先用当前输入和有界上下文做保守判断。只有高置信度、足够 margin（领先差）且不触发 scope、授权或风险门禁时才直达；否则由 `wb-model` 执行 `wb-chat.semantic_routing`。模型失败、超时或输出无效时必须安全回退到 `wb-chat mode=clarify|triage`，不能随机选择 owner。

## 连续性状态

- `active_owner`：最近一次已接受的非 `wb-chat` owner。当前输入含明确延续信号且未发生意图切换时优先保持。
- `pending_handoff`：上轮建议但尚未满足 gate 的 owner。只有当前输入明确确认 gate 时才能变成 direct。
- 两者都通过路由 envelope 随会话历史传递，不写 `sn-cli` 私有配置，不复制 Provider transcript。
- 高风险 owner 不接受只由旧状态或通用“继续”产生的授权。

## 路由证据

路由结果使用 `[[WORKBENCH_ROUTE_V1]]` envelope 与用户原文一起传递。envelope 保存实际 decision、目标 owner、`route_id`、`match_type`、`router_source`、score/margin、复杂度、interaction mode、连续性、追问和缺失上下文。显式、完整短语与确定性兜底也必须有稳定 `router_source`。

实质任务由 `wb-finalize` 解包并写入 `routing_trace`；用户原文单独进入 `original_inputs`。路由是任务进入 owner 的证据，不得复制为 execution step。没有 envelope 时只标记 `unavailable|not_applicable`，不能从最终执行 skill 反推路由。

## 上下文边界

按优先级使用：

1. 当前输入。
2. 最近路由 envelope 中的 `active_owner`、`pending_handoff` 和 `interaction_mode`。
3. 当前 session 最近若干条脱敏消息。
4. 当前 project 最近若干个 TaskRecord 的预期、路由、结果、反馈与 learning 语义摘要。

上下文受 `apps/agent/conf/skill-routing.yaml.semantic_routing` 的条数、字符数、时间和总字节限制。TaskRecord 上下文不读取 `original_inputs`；不得加载全量历史，不包含原始 Provider transcript、代码、diff 或 secret。

## 复合任务的主 Owner

复合输入仍进入 `wb-chat` 语义分流，不做确定性子串直达。若请求位于同一 project，用户明确先要计划、执行顺序或任务拆解，且某个当前已加载 skill 的 description 明确负责规划与下游交接，则该 skill 是主 owner，后续产物由它按自身 Workflow 交接。不能只因为请求提到多个下游产物就要求运营人员选择 skill。

跨 project、多个 owner 仍然并列、缺失答案会改变 scope/授权，或涉及 Git、session、远端写入等高风险动作时，保持 `wb-chat clarify`。

## 接受门禁

直达同时要求：

- primary score 达到 lane 对应阈值；
- primary 与 runner-up 的 margin 达到阈值；
- primary 在当前 project / Agent 可用加载面；
- 没有阻断性 `missing_context`；
- `needs_clarification=false`；
- `interaction_mode` 与目标动作不冲突；
- 高风险 owner 有当前输入明确证据。

阈值是标注集校准后的运行参数，不能把模型自报分数解释为真实概率。

## 质量指标

- `top1_owner_accuracy >= 95%`；
- accepted precision（已直达样本的正确率）`>= 95%`；
- coverage（被直达样本占比）达到配置最低值；
- `zero_false_positive_skills` 必须零误报；
- schema、scope、interaction mode 与 handoff gate 合约必须全部通过。

未达到质量门禁时优先降低覆盖率并增加澄清，不通过下调阈值追求表面直达率。

# Interaction Mode Policy

`interaction_mode` 是用户本轮授权边界，不是 skill mode。它先于 owner 路由生效，用来决定本轮是否允许写入。

## Modes

| mode | 允许 | 禁止 | 常见触发 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `review-only` | 读文件、看 diff、审查问题、列风险 | 修改、创建、删除、格式化、提交 | Review Mode、审查、看是否合理 |
| `discovery-only` | 读本地事实、梳理现状、列未知项 | 修改、创建、删除、直接决策 | Discovery Mode、调研当前项目真实情况 |
| `proposal-only` | 讨论、补证、给建议；用户明确要求时可由事实 owner 写入 pending/draft 方案 | 修改实现、创建当前 contract、把方案晋升为 implemented、Git 交付 | Proposal Mode、优化建议、把方案写下来、架构/数据/规则/skill 边界讨论 |
| `execution` | 按确认范围修改文件、运行命令、验证 | 超出确认范围、混入无关脏改、未确认高风险动作 | Execution Mode、修改、实现、落地、按方案改 |

## Default

普通清晰小修可直接走执行类入口；但以下任务默认进入 `proposal-only`，除非用户明确要求执行：

- 架构、数据契约、目录边界。
- `rules/`、`skills/`、`memory/`、`knowledge/`、project scope、fact owner。
- 长期 Agent 行为、写入 owner、manager、数据落盘规范。

用户显式说“进入 Review Mode / Discovery Mode / Proposal Mode / 本轮不要修改文件 / 先不要写文件”时，本轮必须只读；后续只说“继续”仍保持只读，直到用户明确说“进入 Execution Mode / 修改 / 实现 / 落地 / 按方案改”。

“把方案写下来 / 保存方案 / 写入 pending”是受限写入授权：只允许对应事实 owner 创建或更新明确标记为 pending/draft 的方案产物，仍保持 `proposal-only`。它不等于“实施 / 落地 / 按方案执行”，不能触发 `wb-work`、当前 contract 晋升或 Git 交付。用户明确说“先只聊 / 不要写文件”时，连 pending/draft 也不得写入。

## Execution Preview Gate

从 `review-only`、`discovery-only` 或 `proposal-only` 进入执行前，先输出执行预览：

- 准备修改哪些文件。
- 每个文件修改什么。
- 为什么要改。
- 哪些内容不会动。
- 验证命令。
- 风险和停止条件。

用户确认后才进入 `execution`。如果用户说“现在可以进入执行前准备阶段，但还不要修改文件”，只输出预览，不改文件。

text:
# wb-chat Semantic Routing Prompt

你是 Workbench 的语义路由器。你的唯一职责是判断本轮应由 `wb-chat` 直接承接、转交一个 canonical owner，还是先追问一个关键问题。你不执行目标任务，不输出分析过程，不生成代码或方案。

## 不可覆盖的约束

1. `rules`、单个已注册显式 `$skill` 和全局唯一完整短语已在上游处理；不要推翻上游确定性结果。
2. 每轮最多选择一个 owner。`wb-model` 是内部执行底座，禁止选择。
3. `wb-chat` 承接闲聊、简单问答、轻量状态/路径说明，以及尚不能安全确定 owner 的歧义或复合请求。
4. 同一 project 内的复合请求如果明确先要计划、执行顺序或任务拆解，且一个已加载 skill 的 description 明确负责规划与下游交接，则选择该规划 owner；不要仅因为后续会产生多个交付物就追问。跨 project、owner 仍并列或授权不清时继续 `clarify`。
5. 仓库理解、代码/文档解释、诊断、review 与 health 归 `wb-repo`；实现、修复和验证归 `wb-work`；需求与架构设计归 `wb-design`；重复摩擦复盘和经确认的学习归 `wb-learning`。
6. 先尊重 `interaction_mode`。只读、评估、建议不能升级为写入；从 proposal 转执行必须有当前轮明确授权。
7. 连续任务优先保持 `active_owner`，但只有当前输入是明确延续时才复用。意图实质变化时重新选择。
8. `pending_handoff` 是当前 owner 完成后可能转交的未来 owner，允许与 `primary.skill` 不同。用户满足 gate 后才转交；模糊的“继续”不得授权写入或高风险动作。
9. 对 `wb-git`、`wb-session` 等高风险 owner，必须有当前输入中的明确意图；不得只靠历史、相似度或泛化确认直达。
10. 复杂任务先判断是否缺少会改变 owner、scope 或授权的信息。需要时只生成一个最关键的追问。
11. `score` 是 0 到 1 的相对匹配度，不是概率。综合当前输入、连续性、scope、授权和风险给分；不得为满足阈值虚高打分。
12. 不复制 secret、完整 transcript、代码或 diff。只使用输入中已提供的脱敏摘要。
13. `interaction_mode` 表示授权；`primary.mode` 和 `pending_handoff.mode` 只能使用 skill 的领域 mode 或 `null`，禁止填 `review-only`、`proposal-only` 等授权值。优先使用 skill 的 `canonical_targets`。

## 决策语义

- `answer`：`wb-chat` 可以直接承接日常对话或简单问答。
- `route`：一个 owner 明显优于其它候选，且没有阻断性缺失信息。
- `clarify`：owner、scope 或授权会因答案不同而变化；只问一个问题。

# wb-chat Semantic Routing Prompt

你是 Workbench 的语义路由器。你的唯一职责是判断本轮应由 `wb-chat` 直接承接、转交一个 canonical owner，还是先追问一个关键问题。你不执行目标任务，不输出分析过程，不生成代码或方案。

## 不可覆盖的约束

1. `rules`、单个已注册显式 `$skill` 和全局唯一完整短语已在上游处理；不要推翻上游确定性结果。
2. 每轮最多选择一个 owner。`wb-model` 是内部执行底座，禁止选择。

5. 仓库理解、代码/文档解释、诊断、review 与 health 归 `wb-repo`；实现、修复和验证归 `wb-work`；需求与架构设计归 `wb-design`；重复摩擦复盘和经确认的学习归 `wb-learning`。

# 用途：按 skill 和 Stage 显式选择调用 wb-model 时使用的 sn-cli profile。
# 本机覆盖：configs/local/skills-execution.yaml；只允许覆盖已登记 Stage 的 profile，不在此配置凭据。
# 可选值：profile 必须是本机已配置的 sn-cli profile id；未登记 Stage 不可执行。
# 固定的 fallback 与进度策略由 apps/agent/conf/skill-runtime.yaml 管理，不属于人工 profile 选择。
skills:
  lark-report:
    # 说明：把当日事实整理为正式日报正文。
    # 触发场景：daily-report workflow 完成上下文采集后生成日报。
    daily_generate:
      profile: cx
    # 说明：从本周原始事实中提取可核验的周报证据。
    # 触发场景：weekly-report workflow 进入证据整理阶段。
    weekly_evidence:
      profile: cx
    # 说明：基于证据包编辑面向人的正式周报。
    # 触发场景：weekly-report workflow 完成证据门禁后生成终稿。
    weekly_human_editor:
      profile: cx
  wb-chat:
    # 说明：对确定性路由未命中的请求做有界语义归属判断。
    # 触发场景：本地自判置信度不足且仍可安全判定 owner 时。
    semantic_routing:
      profile: cx-adv
    # 说明：离线评估语义路由对标注集的 owner 预测。
    # 触发场景：运行 routing evaluation 或路由质量门禁。
    routing_evaluation:
      profile: cx-adv
  wb-design:
    # 说明：基于已确认需求与 evidence pack 形成架构设计。
    # 触发场景：设计任务通过 ready_for_design 门禁后。
    architecture:
      profile: cx-deep
    # 说明：独立审查设计的事实依据、约束冲突与实施缺口。
    # 触发场景：架构设计初稿完成、进入设计评审时。
    critic:
      profile: cc
    # 说明：把已通过审查的设计压缩为可执行实施交接。
    # 触发场景：设计状态达到 ready_for_handoff 时。
    implementation_plan:
      profile: cx-deep
  wb-git:
    # 说明：为单个提交生成有信息量的中文 Conventional Commit message。
    # 触发场景：提交批次已确定、需要生成 subject 与 body 时。
    commit_message:
      profile: commit
    # 说明：按功能原子性规划 whole-worktree 的提交批次。
    # 触发场景：wb-git 获得提交授权且在任何 Git 写入之前。
    commit_plan:
      profile: commit
  wb-learning:
    # 说明：从通过本地门禁的复盘证据归纳结构化候选正文。
    # 触发场景：人工或定时 learning review 进入候选合成阶段。
    review_synthesis:
      profile: cx
  wb-repo:
    # 说明：完成仓库结构、局部代码、文档与测试入口的通用只读分析。
    # 触发场景：summary、explain-code、read-doc、test-cmd、docs 或 ask workflow。
    inspect:
      profile: cx-spark
    # 说明：审查 diff、兼容性、回归风险和 reviewer feedback。
    # 触发场景：review 或 feedback workflow。
    review:
      profile: cx-spark
    # 说明：生成问题根因候选、证据和反证路径。
    # 触发场景：diagnose workflow 完成本地事实采集后。
    diagnosis:
      profile: cx-deep
    # 说明：综合仓库检查结果生成健康与质量风险报告。
    # 触发场景：health workflow 或定时 repo-health 任务。
    health_scan:
      profile: cx-spark
    # 说明：对完整仓库理解任务的分片事实做结构化证据提取。
    # 触发场景：understand workflow 遍历每个 leaf component 时。
    understand_evidence:
      profile: cx-spark
    # 说明：汇总分片证据，生成完整功能、服务、调用链和边界报告。
    # 触发场景：understand workflow 完成全部证据分片后。
    understand_report:
      profile: cx-deep

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Service layer for the personal Agent workbench API."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

from wb import build_project_summary_prompt

from wb.api import file_browser
from wb.api import health
from wb.api import projects
from wb.api.workbench_config import (
    _profile_for_selection,
    runtime_config_payload,
    save_workbench_config,
    validate_runtime_config,
    workbench_config,
)
from wb.api.workbench_support import (
    KB_RUNTIME,
    ROOT,
    elapsed_seconds as _elapsed_seconds,
    now as _now,
    read_json as _read_json,
    valid_user_runtime as _valid_user_runtime,
)
from wb.agent.skill_router import configured_available_skills
from wb.agent.skill_router import load_config as load_skill_routing_config
from wb.agent.skill_router import route_text
from wb.agent.chat_router import route_semantically
from wb.agent.route_envelope import (
    ROUTED_CONTENT_PREFIX,
    ROUTED_CONTENT_SEPARATOR,
    decode_routed_content,
)
from wb.task.sn_cli import SnCLIClient, normalize_event, normalize_message


HISTORY_RUNTIME = SnCLIClient()


def _structured_chat_runtime(value: str | None, default: str = "cli") -> str:
    runtime = _valid_user_runtime(value or default, default)
    return runtime if runtime in {"api", "cli"} else "cli"


def _route_context(routing: dict) -> dict:
    context: dict = {
        key: routing[key]
        for key in (
            "decision",
            "skill",
            "mode",
            "workflow",
            "route_id",
            "match_type",
            "router_source",
            "confidence",
            "margin",
            "complexity",
            "interaction_mode",
            "active_owner",
            "pending_handoff",
            "clarification_question",
            "missing_context",
            "reason_codes",
        )
        if routing.get(key) is not None
    }
    if routing.get("decision") == "direct":
        context["instruction"] = (
            "Workbench 已完成路由；先读取并遵守 target skill，"
            "由该 skill 执行边界自检，必要时再交接 canonical owner。"
        )
    elif routing.get("mode") == "answer":
        context["instruction"] = (
            "Workbench 判定本轮由 wb-chat 直接承接；读取并遵守 wb-chat，"
            "完成轻量回答，不执行领域 owner 的工作。"
        )
    else:
        context["instruction"] = (
            "路由门禁未允许直达；读取并遵守 wb-chat，"
            "依据 pending_handoff 和 clarification_question 只做必要澄清或安全分流。"
        )
    return context


def _routed_content(content: str, routing: dict) -> str:
    context = _route_context(routing)
    return (
        ROUTED_CONTENT_PREFIX
        + json.dumps(context, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
        + ROUTED_CONTENT_SEPARATOR
        + content
    )


def _route_memory(routing: dict) -> list[dict]:
    return [{
        "id": "workbench-route-v1",
        "type": "workbench_route",
        "content": json.dumps(
            _route_context(routing),
            ensure_ascii=False,
            separators=(",", ":"),
        ),
        "source": "ai-workbench:wb.api.workbench",
    }]


def _normalize_history_message(message: dict) -> dict:
    normalized = normalize_message(message)
    content = str(normalized.get("content") or "")
    if normalized.get("role") != "user":
        return normalized
    original, routing = decode_routed_content(content)
    if routing is None:
        return normalized
    normalized["content"] = original
    normalized["routing"] = routing
    return normalized


def _history_session_state(record: dict, *, scope_title: str = "") -> dict:
    profile = str(record.get("profile") or "")
    runtime = str(record.get("runtime") or "")
    return {
        **record,
        "session_id": record.get("session_id"),
        "title": record.get("title") or "新会话",
        "runtime": runtime,
        "runtime_profile": profile,
        "project_id": record.get("project_id") or "",
        "project_title": scope_title or record.get("project_id") or "",
        "project_root": record.get("cwd") or "",
        "created_at": record.get("created_at"),
        "updated_at": record.get("updated_at"),
    }


def _runtime_status_from_view(view: dict) -> dict:
    session = view.get("session") or {}
    attempts = list(view.get("attempts") or [])
    executions = list(view.get("executions") or [])
    latest_attempt = attempts[-1] if attempts else {}
    latest_execution = executions[-1] if executions else {}
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "state": latest_attempt.get("state") or latest_execution.get("state") or session.get("state") or "not_started",
        "runtime": session.get("runtime") or latest_execution.get("kind") or "",
        "runtime_profile": session.get("profile") or latest_attempt.get("profile") or "",
        "provider_run_id": latest_attempt.get("run_id") or "",
        "execution_id": latest_execution.get("execution_id") or latest_attempt.get("execution_id") or "",
        "capture_quality": session.get("capture_quality") or latest_execution.get("capture_quality") or "",
    }


def _pending_from_history(view: dict) -> list[dict]:
    active_states = {"pending", "running", "result_pending", "submitted"}
    attempts = [item for item in view.get("attempts") or [] if item.get("state") in active_states]
    if attempts:
        return attempts
    return [item for item in view.get("executions") or [] if item.get("state") in active_states]


def _operator_from_history(
    state: dict,
    messages: list[dict],
    events: list[dict],
    pending: list[dict],
    *,
    runtime_status: dict | None = None,
    outputs: list[dict] | None = None,
) -> dict:
    runtime_status = runtime_status or {}
    outputs = outputs or []
    return {
        "progress": _progress_for_session(
            state, messages, events, pending, runtime_status, outputs,
        ),
        "outputs": outputs,
        "diagnostics_ref": {
            "session_id": state.get("session_id"),
            "runtime_status": runtime_status,
            "event_count": len(events),
            "pending_turn_count": len(pending),
        },
    }


def create_session(
    title: str = "",
    runtime: str | None = None,
    profile: str | None = None,
    project: str | None = None,
    *,
    first_message: str = "",
    wait_seconds: float = 0,
) -> dict:
    if not str(first_message or "").strip():
        raise ValueError("first_message is required；UI 新会话应在首次发送时原子创建")
    config = workbench_config()
    scope = projects.resolve_project(project)
    selected_runtime = _structured_chat_runtime(
        runtime or config["chat_provider"],
        config["chat_provider"],
    )
    selected_profile = _profile_for_selection(config, selected_runtime, profile, "chat_profile")
    clean_title = str(title or "").strip() or _session_title_from_message(first_message)
    session_id = f"chat-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
    routing = _route_message(first_message, scope.id, [])
    submission = HISTORY_RUNTIME.create_session(
        session_id=session_id,
        project_id=scope.id,
        cwd=projects.project_info(scope)["root"],
        title=clean_title,
        runtime=selected_runtime,
        profile=selected_profile,
        content=first_message,
        memory=_route_memory(routing),
        wait_seconds=wait_seconds,
    )
    refreshed = HISTORY_RUNTIME.show(session_id)
    messages = [_normalize_history_message(item) for item in refreshed.get("messages") or []]
    if not messages:
        messages = [_pending_user_message(
            first_message, submission, selected_runtime, selected_profile, routing,
        )]
    events = [normalize_event(item) for item in refreshed.get("events") or []]
    state = _history_session_state(refreshed.get("session") or {}, scope_title=scope.title)
    state["runtime"] = state.get("runtime") or selected_runtime
    state["runtime_profile"] = state.get("runtime_profile") or selected_profile
    runtime_status = _runtime_status_from_view(refreshed)
    pending = [submission] if submission.get("state") in {"pending", "queued", "running", "result_pending"} else []
    return {
        **state,
        "messages": messages,
        "events": events,
        "runtime_status": runtime_status,
        "submission": submission,
        "routing": routing,
        "latest_context": refreshed.get("latest_context"),
        "pending_turns": pending,
        "operator": _operator_from_history(
            state, messages, events, pending, runtime_status=runtime_status,
        ),
    }


def _session_title_from_message(content: str) -> str:
    lines = [line.strip() for line in str(content or "").splitlines()]
    first_line = next((line for line in lines if line), "新会话")
    match = re.match(r"^(.+?[。！？!?])", first_line)
    title = match.group(1).strip() if match else first_line
    return title[:36] + "..." if len(title) > 36 else title


def list_sessions(project: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    project_id = projects.resolve_project(project).id if project else None
    return [_history_session_state(item) for item in HISTORY_RUNTIME.list_sessions(project_id)]


def get_session(session_id: str) -> dict:
    view = HISTORY_RUNTIME.show(session_id)
    state = _history_session_state(view.get("session") or {})
    messages = [_normalize_history_message(item) for item in view.get("messages") or []]
    events = [normalize_event(item) for item in view.get("events") or []]
    pending = _pending_from_history(view)
    runtime_status = HISTORY_RUNTIME.runtime_run_status(session_id)
    if not pending and runtime_status.get("state") in {"pending", "running", "result_pending"}:
        pending = [{
            "run_id": runtime_status.get("provider_run_id"),
            "state": runtime_status.get("state"),
            "queue_position": runtime_status.get("queue_position", 0),
        }]
    linked_outputs = _session_output_refs(messages, events, [])
    operator = _operator_from_history(
        state,
        messages,
        events,
        pending,
        runtime_status=runtime_status,
        outputs=linked_outputs,
    )
    return {
        **state,
        "messages": messages,
        "events": events,
        "linked_outputs": linked_outputs,
        "latest_context": view.get("latest_context"),
        "pending_turns": pending,
        "runtime_status": runtime_status,
        "runtime_log_tail": HISTORY_RUNTIME.logs(session_id, max_bytes=16_000),
        "operator": operator,
    }


def delete_session(session_id: str) -> dict:
    stop_session_runtime(session_id)
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.delete(session_id)


def delete_sessions(session_ids: list[str]) -> dict:
    if not session_ids:
        raise ValueError("session_ids is required")
    deleted = []
    errors = []
    for session_id in session_ids:
        try:
            deleted.append(delete_session(str(session_id)))
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            errors.append({"session_id": str(session_id), "error": str(exc)})
    return {"ok": not errors, "deleted": deleted, "errors": errors}


def run_project_summary(
    question: str,
    *,
    profile: str | None = None,
    timeout_seconds: int = 300,
    max_context_bytes: int = 60_000,
) -> dict:
    config = workbench_config()
    selected_profile = _profile_for_selection(config, "api", profile, "runtime_profile")
    context_payload = build_project_summary_prompt(
        ROOT,
        question,
        max_context_bytes=max_context_bytes,
    )
    run = HISTORY_RUNTIME.run_task(
        profile=selected_profile,
        project_id=projects.resolve_project(None).id,
        cwd=str(ROOT),
        prompt=context_payload["prompt"],
        timeout_seconds=max(30, int(timeout_seconds or 300)),
    )
    result = run.get("result") if isinstance(run, dict) else {}
    result = result if isinstance(result, dict) else {}
    summary = str(result.get("assistant_message") or result.get("summary") or "").strip()
    return {
        "ok": bool(run.get("ok", True)) and str(run.get("state")) == "done",
        "runtime": "api",
        "profile": selected_profile,
        "summary": summary,
        "context": {
            "question": context_payload["question"],
            "context_bytes": context_payload["context_bytes"],
            "max_context_bytes": context_payload["max_context_bytes"],
            "truncated": context_payload["truncated"],
            "sources": context_payload["sources"],
        },
        "run": run,
    }


def list_runtime_runs() -> list[dict]:
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.list_runtime_runs()


def start_runtime_run(
    *, runtime: str | None, profile: str | None, prompt: str, timeout_seconds: int,
    model: str = "", reasoning_effort: str = "", provider_overrides: dict | None = None,
    command: str | None = None, provider_env: dict | None = None,
) -> dict:
    if command:
        raise ValueError("command 直传已停用；请在 sn-cli profile 中声明 binary/args")
    if provider_env:
        raise ValueError("provider_env 直传已停用；请在 sn-cli profile/preset 中声明 env")
    config = workbench_config()
    selected_runtime = _valid_user_runtime(runtime or config["runtime_provider"], config["runtime_provider"])
    selected_profile = _profile_for_selection(config, selected_runtime, profile, "runtime_profile")
    overrides = dict(provider_overrides or {})
    if model:
        overrides["model"] = model
    if reasoning_effort:
        overrides["reasoning_effort"] = reasoning_effort
    scope = projects.resolve_project(None)
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.start_runtime_run(
        runtime=selected_runtime,
        profile=selected_profile,
        project_id=scope.id,
        cwd=projects.project_info(scope)["root"],
        prompt=prompt,
        timeout_seconds=max(1, int(timeout_seconds)),
        provider_overrides=overrides,
    )


def runtime_run_status(run_id: str) -> dict:
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.runtime_run_status(run_id)


def runtime_run_logs(run_id: str) -> dict:
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.logs(run_id)


def send_runtime_run(run_id: str, text: str) -> dict:
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.send_runtime_run(run_id, text)


def stop_runtime_run(run_id: str) -> dict:
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.stop(run_id)


def session_runtime_status(session_id: str) -> dict:
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.runtime_run_status(session_id)


def session_runtime_logs(session_id: str, max_bytes: int = 40_000) -> dict:
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.logs(session_id, max_bytes=max_bytes)


def update_session_runtime(session_id: str, runtime: str | None = None, profile: str | None = None) -> dict:
    current = _history_session_state((HISTORY_RUNTIME.show(session_id).get("session") or {}))
    if session_runtime_status(session_id).get("state") in {"pending", "running", "result_pending"}:
        raise RuntimeError("当前会话仍有执行中的消息，请完成或停止后再切换助手。")
    config = workbench_config()
    selected_runtime = _structured_chat_runtime(
        runtime or current.get("runtime") or config["chat_provider"],
        config["chat_provider"],
    )
    selected_profile = _profile_for_selection(config, selected_runtime, profile, "chat_profile")
    updated = HISTORY_RUNTIME.configure(session_id, selected_runtime, selected_profile)
    return {**_history_session_state(updated), "ok": True, "warnings": []}


def stop_session_runtime(session_id: str) -> dict:
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.stop(session_id)


def _classify(text: str) -> str:
    lowered = text.lower()
    content_words = ["出一篇", "生成内容", "写小红书", "朋友圈文案", "家长群", "书单", "读书笔记", "文案", "图文", "短视频"]
    search_words = ["搜索", "查一下", "找一下", "有哪些", "调研", "素材"]
    design_words = ["设计", "方案", "规划", "架构"]
    if any(word in lowered for word in content_words):
        return "content"
    if any(word in lowered for word in search_words):
        return "search"
    if any(word in lowered for word in design_words):
        return "design"
    return "qa"


def _route_message(content: str, project_id: str, messages: list[dict]) -> dict:
    routing_config = load_skill_routing_config()
    available_skills = configured_available_skills(
        routing_config,
        project_id=project_id,
    )
    routing = route_text(
        content,
        routing_config,
        project_id=project_id,
        available_skills=available_skills,
    )
    if routing.get("match_type") == "fallback":
        routing = route_semantically(
            content,
            routing_config,
            project_id=project_id,
            available_skills=available_skills,
            messages=messages,
        )
    return routing


def _pending_user_message(
    content: str,

    runtime: str,
    profile: str,
    routing: dict,
) -> dict:
    return {

        "role": "user",
        "content": content,
        "ts": _now(),
        "pending": True,
        "turn_id": submission.get("turn_id") or submission.get("run_id"),
        "runtime": runtime,
        "runtime_profile": profile,
        "routing": routing,
    }


def add_message(

    profile: str | None = None,
) -> dict:
    view = HISTORY_RUNTIME.show(session_id)
    state = _history_session_state(view.get("session") or {})

        runtime or state.get("runtime") or config["chat_provider"],
        config["chat_provider"],
    )
    selected_profile = _profile_for_selection(
        config,
        selected_runtime,
        profile or state.get("runtime_profile"),
        "chat_profile",
    )
    if not selected_profile:
        raise RuntimeError("当前会话没有可用的 runtime profile")
    project_id = str(state.get("project_id") or projects.resolve_project(None).id)
    routing = _route_message(
        content,
        project_id,
        [_normalize_history_message(item) for item in view.get("messages") or []],
    )
    submission = HISTORY_RUNTIME.submit_turn(
        session_id,
        runtime=selected_runtime,
        profile=selected_profile,
        project_id=project_id,
        cwd=str(state.get("cwd") or state.get("project_root") or ROOT),
        content=content,
        memory=_route_memory(routing),
        wait_seconds=wait_seconds,
    )
    refreshed = HISTORY_RUNTIME.show(session_id)
    messages = [_normalize_history_message(item) for item in refreshed.get("messages") or []]
    submitted_turn_id = str(submission.get("turn_id") or "")
    has_submitted_message = (
        any(str(message.get("turn_id") or "") == submitted_turn_id for message in messages)
        if submitted_turn_id
        else any(
            message.get("role") == "user" and str(message.get("content") or "") == content
            for message in messages[-2:]
        )
    )
    if not has_submitted_message:
        messages.append(_pending_user_message(
            content, submission, selected_runtime, selected_profile, routing,
        ))
    events = [normalize_event(item) for item in refreshed.get("events") or []]
    runtime_status = _runtime_status_from_view(refreshed)
    pending = [submission] if submission.get("state") in {"pending", "queued", "running", "result_pending"} else []

        "id": f"pending-{submission.get('run_id') or uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}",

        "ts": _now(),
        "pending": True,
        "turn_id": submission.get("run_id"),
        "runtime": selected_runtime,
        "runtime_profile": selected_profile,
    }
    return {
        "message": messages[-1] if messages and messages[-1].get("role") == "assistant" else placeholder,

        "pending_turns": pending,
        "operator": _operator_from_history(

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Service layer for the personal Agent workbench API."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

from wb import build_project_summary_prompt

from wb.api import file_browser
from wb.api import health
from wb.api import projects
from wb.api.workbench_config import (
    _profile_for_selection,
    runtime_config_payload,
    save_workbench_config,
    validate_runtime_config,
    workbench_config,
)
from wb.api.workbench_support import (
    KB_RUNTIME,
    ROOT,
    elapsed_seconds as _elapsed_seconds,
    now as _now,
    read_json as _read_json,
    valid_user_runtime as _valid_user_runtime,
)
from wb.agent.skill_router import configured_available_skills
from wb.agent.skill_router import load_config as load_skill_routing_config
from wb.agent.skill_router import route_text
from wb.agent.chat_router import route_semantically
from wb.agent.route_envelope import (
    ROUTED_CONTENT_PREFIX,
    ROUTED_CONTENT_SEPARATOR,
    decode_routed_content,
)
from wb.task.sn_cli import SnCLIClient, normalize_event, normalize_message


HISTORY_RUNTIME = SnCLIClient()


def _structured_chat_runtime(value: str | None, default: str = "cli") -> str:
    runtime = _valid_user_runtime(value or default, default)
    return runtime if runtime in {"api", "cli"} else "cli"


def _route_context(routing: dict) -> dict:
    context: dict = {
        key: routing[key]
        for key in (
            "decision",
            "skill",
            "mode",
            "workflow",
            "route_id",
            "match_type",
            "router_source",
            "confidence",
            "margin",
            "complexity",
            "interaction_mode",
            "active_owner",
            "pending_handoff",
            "clarification_question",
            "missing_context",
            "reason_codes",
        )
        if routing.get(key) is not None
    }
    if routing.get("decision") == "direct":
        context["instruction"] = (
            "Workbench 已完成路由；先读取并遵守 target skill，"
            "由该 skill 执行边界自检，必要时再交接 canonical owner。"
        )
    elif routing.get("mode") == "answer":
        context["instruction"] = (
            "Workbench 判定本轮由 wb-chat 直接承接；读取并遵守 wb-chat，"
            "完成轻量回答，不执行领域 owner 的工作。"
        )
    else:
        context["instruction"] = (
            "路由门禁未允许直达；读取并遵守 wb-chat，"
            "依据 pending_handoff 和 clarification_question 只做必要澄清或安全分流。"
        )
    return context


def _routed_content(content: str, routing: dict) -> str:
    context = _route_context(routing)
    return (
        ROUTED_CONTENT_PREFIX
        + json.dumps(context, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
        + ROUTED_CONTENT_SEPARATOR
        + content
    )


def _route_memory(routing: dict) -> list[dict]:
    return [{
        "id": "workbench-route-v1",
        "type": "workbench_route",
        "content": json.dumps(
            _route_context(routing),
            ensure_ascii=False,
            separators=(",", ":"),
        ),
        "source": "ai-workbench:wb.api.workbench",
    }]


def _normalize_history_message(message: dict) -> dict:
    normalized = normalize_message(message)
    content = str(normalized.get("content") or "")
    if normalized.get("role") != "user":
        return normalized
    original, routing = decode_routed_content(content)
    if routing is None:
        return normalized
    normalized["content"] = original
    normalized["routing"] = routing
    return normalized


def _history_session_state(record: dict, *, scope_title: str = "") -> dict:
    profile = str(record.get("profile") or "")
    runtime = str(record.get("runtime") or "")
    return {
        **record,
        "session_id": record.get("session_id"),
        "title": record.get("title") or "新会话",
        "runtime": runtime,
        "runtime_profile": profile,
        "project_id": record.get("project_id") or "",
        "project_title": scope_title or record.get("project_id") or "",
        "project_root": record.get("cwd") or "",
        "created_at": record.get("created_at"),
        "updated_at": record.get("updated_at"),
    }


def _runtime_status_from_view(view: dict) -> dict:
    session = view.get("session") or {}
    attempts = list(view.get("attempts") or [])
    executions = list(view.get("executions") or [])
    latest_attempt = attempts[-1] if attempts else {}
    latest_execution = executions[-1] if executions else {}
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "state": latest_attempt.get("state") or latest_execution.get("state") or session.get("state") or "not_started",
        "runtime": session.get("runtime") or latest_execution.get("kind") or "",
        "runtime_profile": session.get("profile") or latest_attempt.get("profile") or "",
        "provider_run_id": latest_attempt.get("run_id") or "",
        "execution_id": latest_execution.get("execution_id") or latest_attempt.get("execution_id") or "",
        "capture_quality": session.get("capture_quality") or latest_execution.get("capture_quality") or "",
    }


def _pending_from_history(view: dict) -> list[dict]:
    active_states = {"pending", "running", "result_pending", "submitted"}
    attempts = [item for item in view.get("attempts") or [] if item.get("state") in active_states]
    if attempts:
        return attempts
    return [item for item in view.get("executions") or [] if item.get("state") in active_states]


def _operator_from_history(
    state: dict,
    messages: list[dict],
    events: list[dict],
    pending: list[dict],
    *,
    runtime_status: dict | None = None,
    outputs: list[dict] | None = None,
) -> dict:
    runtime_status = runtime_status or {}
    outputs = outputs or []
    return {
        "progress": _progress_for_session(
            state, messages, events, pending, runtime_status, outputs,
        ),
        "outputs": outputs,
        "diagnostics_ref": {
            "session_id": state.get("session_id"),
            "runtime_status": runtime_status,
            "event_count": len(events),
            "pending_turn_count": len(pending),
        },
    }


def create_session(
    title: str = "",
    runtime: str | None = None,
    profile: str | None = None,
    project: str | None = None,
    *,
    first_message: str = "",
    wait_seconds: float = 0,
) -> dict:
    if not str(first_message or "").strip():
        raise ValueError("first_message is required；UI 新会话应在首次发送时原子创建")
    config = workbench_config()
    scope = projects.resolve_project(project)
    selected_runtime = _structured_chat_runtime(
        runtime or config["chat_provider"],
        config["chat_provider"],
    )
    selected_profile = _profile_for_selection(config, selected_runtime, profile, "chat_profile")
    clean_title = str(title or "").strip() or _session_title_from_message(first_message)
    session_id = f"chat-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
    routing = _route_message(first_message, scope.id, [])
    submission = HISTORY_RUNTIME.create_session(
        session_id=session_id,
        project_id=scope.id,
        cwd=projects.project_info(scope)["root"],
        title=clean_title,
        runtime=selected_runtime,
        profile=selected_profile,
        content=first_message,
        memory=_route_memory(routing),
        wait_seconds=wait_seconds,
    )
    refreshed = HISTORY_RUNTIME.show(session_id)
    messages = [_normalize_history_message(item) for item in refreshed.get("messages") or []]
    if not messages:
        messages = [_pending_user_message(
            first_message, submission, selected_runtime, selected_profile, routing,
        )]
    events = [normalize_event(item) for item in refreshed.get("events") or []]
    state = _history_session_state(refreshed.get("session") or {}, scope_title=scope.title)
    state["runtime"] = state.get("runtime") or selected_runtime
    state["runtime_profile"] = state.get("runtime_profile") or selected_profile
    runtime_status = _runtime_status_from_view(refreshed)
    pending = [submission] if submission.get("state") in {"pending", "queued", "running", "result_pending"} else []
    return {
        **state,
        "messages": messages,
        "events": events,
        "runtime_status": runtime_status,
        "submission": submission,
        "routing": routing,
        "latest_context": refreshed.get("latest_context"),
        "pending_turns": pending,
        "operator": _operator_from_history(
            state, messages, events, pending, runtime_status=runtime_status,
        ),
    }


def _session_title_from_message(content: str) -> str:
    lines = [line.strip() for line in str(content or "").splitlines()]
    first_line = next((line for line in lines if line), "新会话")
    match = re.match(r"^(.+?[。！？!?])", first_line)
    title = match.group(1).strip() if match else first_line
    return title[:36] + "..." if len(title) > 36 else title


def list_sessions(project: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    project_id = projects.resolve_project(project).id if project else None
    return [_history_session_state(item) for item in HISTORY_RUNTIME.list_sessions(project_id)]


def get_session(session_id: str) -> dict:
    view = HISTORY_RUNTIME.show(session_id)
    state = _history_session_state(view.get("session") or {})
    messages = [_normalize_history_message(item) for item in view.get("messages") or []]
    events = [normalize_event(item) for item in view.get("events") or []]
    pending = _pending_from_history(view)
    runtime_status = HISTORY_RUNTIME.runtime_run_status(session_id)
    if not pending and runtime_status.get("state") in {"pending", "running", "result_pending"}:
        pending = [{
            "run_id": runtime_status.get("provider_run_id"),
            "state": runtime_status.get("state"),
            "queue_position": runtime_status.get("queue_position", 0),
        }]
    linked_outputs = _session_output_refs(messages, events, [])
    operator = _operator_from_history(
        state,
        messages,
        events,
        pending,
        runtime_status=runtime_status,
        outputs=linked_outputs,
    )
    return {
        **state,
        "messages": messages,
        "events": events,
        "linked_outputs": linked_outputs,
        "latest_context": view.get("latest_context"),
        "pending_turns": pending,
        "runtime_status": runtime_status,
        "runtime_log_tail": HISTORY_RUNTIME.logs(session_id, max_bytes=16_000),
        "operator": operator,
    }


def delete_session(session_id: str) -> dict:
    stop_session_runtime(session_id)
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.delete(session_id)


def delete_sessions(session_ids: list[str]) -> dict:
    if not session_ids:
        raise ValueError("session_ids is required")
    deleted = []
    errors = []
    for session_id in session_ids:
        try:
            deleted.append(delete_session(str(session_id)))
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            errors.append({"session_id": str(session_id), "error": str(exc)})
    return {"ok": not errors, "deleted": deleted, "errors": errors}


def run_project_summary(
    question: str,
    *,
    profile: str | None = None,
    timeout_seconds: int = 300,
    max_context_bytes: int = 60_000,
) -> dict:
    config = workbench_config()
    selected_profile = _profile_for_selection(config, "api", profile, "runtime_profile")
    context_payload = build_project_summary_prompt(
        ROOT,
        question,
        max_context_bytes=max_context_bytes,
    )
    run = HISTORY_RUNTIME.run_task(
        profile=selected_profile,
        project_id=projects.resolve_project(None).id,
        cwd=str(ROOT),
        prompt=context_payload["prompt"],
        timeout_seconds=max(30, int(timeout_seconds or 300)),
    )
    result = run.get("result") if isinstance(run, dict) else {}
    result = result if isinstance(result, dict) else {}
    summary = str(result.get("assistant_message") or result.get("summary") or "").strip()
    return {
        "ok": bool(run.get("ok", True)) and str(run.get("state")) == "done",
        "runtime": "api",
        "profile": selected_profile,
        "summary": summary,
        "context": {
            "question": context_payload["question"],
            "context_bytes": context_payload["context_bytes"],
            "max_context_bytes": context_payload["max_context_bytes"],
            "truncated": context_payload["truncated"],
            "sources": context_payload["sources"],
        },
        "run": run,
    }


def list_runtime_runs() -> list[dict]:
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.list_runtime_runs()


def start_runtime_run(
    *, runtime: str | None, profile: str | None, prompt: str, timeout_seconds: int,
    model: str = "", reasoning_effort: str = "", provider_overrides: dict | None = None,
    command: str | None = None, provider_env: dict | None = None,
) -> dict:
    if command:
        raise ValueError("command 直传已停用；请在 sn-cli profile 中声明 binary/args")
    if provider_env:
        raise ValueError("provider_env 直传已停用；请在 sn-cli profile/preset 中声明 env")
    config = workbench_config()
    selected_runtime = _valid_user_runtime(runtime or config["runtime_provider"], config["runtime_provider"])
    selected_profile = _profile_for_selection(config, selected_runtime, profile, "runtime_profile")
    overrides = dict(provider_overrides or {})
    if model:
        overrides["model"] = model
    if reasoning_effort:
        overrides["reasoning_effort"] = reasoning_effort
    scope = projects.resolve_project(None)
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.start_runtime_run(
        runtime=selected_runtime,
        profile=selected_profile,
        project_id=scope.id,
        cwd=projects.project_info(scope)["root"],
        prompt=prompt,
        timeout_seconds=max(1, int(timeout_seconds)),
        provider_overrides=overrides,
    )


def runtime_run_status(run_id: str) -> dict:
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.runtime_run_status(run_id)


def runtime_run_logs(run_id: str) -> dict:
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.logs(run_id)


def send_runtime_run(run_id: str, text: str) -> dict:
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.send_runtime_run(run_id, text)


def stop_runtime_run(run_id: str) -> dict:
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.stop(run_id)


def session_runtime_status(session_id: str) -> dict:
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.runtime_run_status(session_id)


def session_runtime_logs(session_id: str, max_bytes: int = 40_000) -> dict:
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.logs(session_id, max_bytes=max_bytes)


def update_session_runtime(session_id: str, runtime: str | None = None, profile: str | None = None) -> dict:
    current = _history_session_state((HISTORY_RUNTIME.show(session_id).get("session") or {}))
    if session_runtime_status(session_id).get("state") in {"pending", "running", "result_pending"}:
        raise RuntimeError("当前会话仍有执行中的消息，请完成或停止后再切换助手。")
    config = workbench_config()
    selected_runtime = _structured_chat_runtime(
        runtime or current.get("runtime") or config["chat_provider"],
        config["chat_provider"],
    )
    selected_profile = _profile_for_selection(config, selected_runtime, profile, "chat_profile")
    updated = HISTORY_RUNTIME.configure(session_id, selected_runtime, selected_profile)
    return {**_history_session_state(updated), "ok": True, "warnings": []}


def stop_session_runtime(session_id: str) -> dict:
    return HISTORY_RUNTIME.stop(session_id)


def _classify(text: str) -> str:
    lowered = text.lower()
    content_words = ["出一篇", "生成内容", "写小红书", "朋友圈文案", "家长群", "书单", "读书笔记", "文案", "图文", "短视频"]
    search_words = ["搜索", "查一下", "找一下", "有哪些", "调研", "素材"]
    design_words = ["设计", "方案", "规划", "架构"]
    if any(word in lowered for word in content_words):
        return "content"
    if any(word in lowered for word in search_words):
        return "search"
    if any(word in lowered for word in design_words):
        return "design"
    return "qa"


def _route_message(content: str, project_id: str, messages: list[dict]) -> dict:
    routing_config = load_skill_routing_config()
    available_skills = configured_available_skills(
        routing_config,
        project_id=project_id,
    )
    routing = route_text(
        content,
        routing_config,
        project_id=project_id,
        available_skills=available_skills,
    )
    if routing.get("match_type") == "fallback":
        routing = route_semantically(
            content,
            routing_config,
            project_id=project_id,
            available_skills=available_skills,
            messages=messages,
        )
    return routing


def _pending_user_message(
    content: str,
    submission: dict,
    runtime: str,
    profile: str,
    routing: dict,
) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": f"pending-user-{submission.get('turn_id') or submission.get('run_id') or uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}",
        "role": "user",
        "content": content,
        "ts": _now(),
        "pending": True,
        "turn_id": submission.get("turn_id") or submission.get("run_id"),
        "runtime": runtime,
        "runtime_profile": profile,
        "routing": routing,
    }


def add_message(
    session_id: str,
    content: str,
    wait_seconds: float = 0,
    *,
    runtime: str | None = None,
    profile: str | None = None,
) -> dict:
    view = HISTORY_RUNTIME.show(session_id)
    state = _history_session_state(view.get("session") or {})
    config = workbench_config()
    selected_runtime = _structured_chat_runtime(
        runtime or state.get("runtime") or config["chat_provider"],
        config["chat_provider"],
    )
    selected_profile = _profile_for_selection(
        config,
        selected_runtime,
        profile or state.get("runtime_profile"),
        "chat_profile",
    )
    if not selected_profile:
        raise RuntimeError("当前会话没有可用的 runtime profile")
    project_id = str(state.get("project_id") or projects.resolve_project(None).id)
    routing = _route_message(
        content,
        project_id,
        [_normalize_history_message(item) for item in view.get("messages") or []],
    )
    submission = HISTORY_RUNTIME.submit_turn(
        session_id,
        runtime=selected_runtime,
        profile=selected_profile,
        project_id=project_id,
        cwd=str(state.get("cwd") or state.get("project_root") or ROOT),
        content=content,
        memory=_route_memory(routing),
        wait_seconds=wait_seconds,
    )
    refreshed = HISTORY_RUNTIME.show(session_id)
    messages = [_normalize_history_message(item) for item in refreshed.get("messages") or []]
    submitted_turn_id = str(submission.get("turn_id") or "")
    has_submitted_message = (
        any(str(message.get("turn_id") or "") == submitted_turn_id for message in messages)
        if submitted_turn_id
        else any(
            message.get("role") == "user" and str(message.get("content") or "") == content
            for message in messages[-2:]
        )
    )
    if not has_submitted_message:
        messages.append(_pending_user_message(
            content, submission, selected_runtime, selected_profile, routing,
        ))
    events = [normalize_event(item) for item in refreshed.get("events") or []]
    runtime_status = _runtime_status_from_view(refreshed)
    pending = [submission] if submission.get("state") in {"pending", "queued", "running", "result_pending"} else []
    placeholder = {
        "id": f"pending-{submission.get('run_id') or uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}",
        "role": "assistant",
        "content": "已提交给 runtime provider，正在后台执行。",
        "ts": _now(),
        "pending": True,
        "turn_id": submission.get("run_id"),
        "runtime": selected_runtime,
        "runtime_profile": selected_profile,
    }
    return {
        "message": messages[-1] if messages and messages[-1].get("role") == "assistant" else placeholder,
        "messages": messages,
        "events": events,
        "runtime": submission,
        "routing": routing,
        "session": _history_session_state(refreshed.get("session") or {}),
        "latest_context": refreshed.get("latest_context"),
        "pending_turns": pending,
        "operator": _operator_from_history(
            state, messages, events, pending, runtime_status=runtime_status,
        ),
    }

def kb_search(query: str, modality: str = "all", topk: int = 10, *, project: str | None = None) -> dict:
    if not query.strip():
        return {"ok": False, "error": "query is required"}
    scope = projects.resolve_project(project)
    cmd = [
        sys.executable,
        str(KB_RUNTIME),
        "--project",
        scope.id,
        "search",
        "--query",
        query,
        "--modality",
        modality,
        "--topk",
        str(topk),
        "--json",
    ]
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=ROOT, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60, check=False)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        return {"ok": False, "error": (proc.stderr or proc.stdout).strip(), "rows": []}
    try:
        payload = json.loads(proc.stdout or "{}")
        return {"ok": True, "rows": payload.get("results", []), "retrieval": payload.get("retrieval", {})}
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return {"ok": False, "error": f"search JSON parse failed: {exc}", "raw": proc.stdout, "rows": []}

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from wb.agent.chat_router import (
    SemanticRoutingError,
    build_route_context,
    infer_interaction_mode,
    render_semantic_prompt,
    route_semantically,
)
from wb.agent.skill_router import (
    DEFAULT_CONFIG,
    configured_available_skills,
    load_config,
)


class ChatRouterTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls) -> None:
        cls.config = load_config(DEFAULT_CONFIG)
        cls.available = configured_available_skills(
            cls.config,
            project_id="shuheng",
            include_develop=True,
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _route_result(
        skill: str,
        *,
        score: float = 0.96,
        alternative_skill: str = "wb-chat",
        alternative_score: float = 0.20,
        mode: str | None = None,
        workflow: str | None = None,
        interaction_mode: str | None = None,
    ) -> str:
        return json.dumps(
            {
                "schema_version": 1,
                "decision": "route",
                "complexity": "complex",
                "interaction_mode": interaction_mode,
                "primary": {
                    "skill": skill,
                    "score": score,
                    "mode": mode,
                    "workflow": workflow,
                },
                "alternatives": [
                    {
                        "skill": alternative_skill,
                        "score": alternative_score,
                        "mode": None,
                        "workflow": None,
                    }
                ],
                "needs_clarification": False,
                "clarification_question": None,
                "missing_context": [],
                "pending_handoff": None,
                "reason_codes": ["owner-match"],
            },
            ensure_ascii=False,
        )

    def test_lightweight_chat_is_answered_without_model(self) -> None:
        def fail_runner(prompt: str, stage: str, timeout: int) -> str:
            del prompt, stage, timeout
            raise AssertionError("轻量问答不应调用模型")

        result = route_semantically(
            "什么是幂等",
            self.config,
            project_id="shuheng",
            available_skills=self.available,
            model_runner=fail_runner,
        )

        self.assertEqual(result["decision"], "chat")
        self.assertEqual(result["mode"], "answer")
        self.assertEqual(result["router_source"], "self")

    def test_implementation_plan_wording_remains_proposal_only(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(
            infer_interaction_mode("帮我设计一个实现方案"),
            "proposal-only",
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            infer_interaction_mode("把方案写下来"),
            "proposal-only",
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            infer_interaction_mode("把这个想法整理成方案并保存"),
            "proposal-only",
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            infer_interaction_mode("按方案开始实现这个功能"),
            "execution",
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            infer_interaction_mode("先分析问题，再判断是否需要修复"),
            "review-only",
        )

    def test_active_owner_continues_on_unambiguous_confirmation(self) -> None:
        messages = [
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": "看下这个仓库",
                "routing": {
                    "decision": "direct",
                    "skill": "wb-repo",
                    "mode": "diagnose",
                },
            }
        ]

        result = route_semantically(
            "继续",
            self.config,
            project_id="shuheng",
            available_skills=self.available,
            messages=messages,
        )

        self.assertEqual(result["decision"], "direct")
        self.assertEqual(result["skill"], "wb-repo")
        self.assertEqual(result["match_type"], "semantic-active-owner")

    def test_workbench_skill_path_question_is_resolved_locally(self) -> None:
        def fail_runner(prompt: str, stage: str, timeout: int) -> str:
            del prompt, stage, timeout
            raise AssertionError("Workbench 轻量路径问答不应调用模型")

        result = route_semantically(
            "wb-repo 的入口文件在哪里？",
            self.config,
            project_id="shuheng",
            available_skills=self.available,
            model_runner=fail_runner,
        )

        self.assertEqual(result["decision"], "chat")
        self.assertEqual(result["mode"], "answer")
        self.assertEqual(result["match_type"], "semantic-self-answer")

    def test_execution_authorization_switches_design_owner_through_model(self) -> None:
        messages = [
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": "先设计方案",
                "routing": {
                    "decision": "direct",
                    "skill": "wb-design",
                    "interaction_mode": "proposal-only",
                },
            }
        ]
        calls: list[tuple[str, str, int]] = []

        def runner(prompt: str, stage: str, timeout: int) -> str:
            calls.append((prompt, stage, timeout))
            return self._route_result(
                "wb-work",
                mode="implement",
                interaction_mode="execution",
            )

        result = route_semantically(
            "好的，按照这个来落地",
            self.config,
            project_id="shuheng",
            available_skills=self.available,
            messages=messages,
            model_runner=runner,
        )

        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)
        self.assertEqual(calls[0][1], "wb-chat.semantic_routing")
        self.assertEqual(result["decision"], "direct")
        self.assertEqual(result["skill"], "wb-work")
        self.assertEqual(result["interaction_mode"], "execution")

    def test_current_owner_can_carry_a_different_future_handoff(self) -> None:
        def runner(prompt: str, stage: str, timeout: int) -> str:
            del prompt, stage, timeout
            payload = json.loads(
                self._route_result(
                    "wb-repo",
                    mode="diagnose",
                    alternative_skill="wb-work",
                    interaction_mode="review-only",
                )
            )
            payload["pending_handoff"] = {
                "skill": "wb-work",
                "mode": "repair",
                "workflow": None,
                "gate": "explicit-request",
                "reason": "诊断确认后才可修复",
            }
            return json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)

        result = route_semantically(
            "先分析当前仓库的问题，再判断是否需要修复",
            self.config,
            project_id="shuheng",
            available_skills=self.available,
            model_runner=runner,
        )

        self.assertEqual(result["decision"], "direct")
        self.assertEqual(result["active_owner"]["skill"], "wb-repo")
        self.assertEqual(result["pending_handoff"]["skill"], "wb-work")
        self.assertEqual(result["interaction_mode"], "review-only")

    def test_continue_prefers_active_owner_over_future_handoff(self) -> None:
        messages = [
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": "先诊断再设计",
                "routing": {
                    "decision": "direct",
                    "skill": "wb-repo",
                    "mode": "diagnose",
                    "active_owner": {
                        "skill": "wb-repo",
                        "mode": "diagnose",
                        "workflow": None,
                    },
                    "pending_handoff": {
                        "skill": "wb-design",
                        "mode": None,
                        "workflow": None,
                        "gate": "confirmation",
                        "reason": "诊断后再设计",
                    },
                },
            }
        ]

        result = route_semantically(
            "继续分析",
            self.config,
            project_id="shuheng",
            available_skills=self.available,
            messages=messages,
        )

        self.assertEqual(result["decision"], "direct")
        self.assertEqual(result["skill"], "wb-repo")
        self.assertEqual(result["match_type"], "semantic-active-owner")
        self.assertEqual(result["pending_handoff"]["skill"], "wb-design")

    def test_generic_confirmation_does_not_authorize_pending_write(self) -> None:
        messages = [
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": "可以转实现吗",
                "routing": {
                    "decision": "chat",
                    "skill": "wb-chat",
                    "interaction_mode": "proposal-only",
                    "pending_handoff": {
                        "skill": "wb-work",
                        "mode": "implement",
                        "workflow": None,
                        "gate": "confirmation",
                        "reason": "等待执行授权",
                    },
                },
            }
        ]

        def unavailable(prompt: str, stage: str, timeout: int) -> str:
            del prompt, stage, timeout
            raise SemanticRoutingError("unavailable")

        result = route_semantically(
            "好的",
            self.config,
            project_id="shuheng",
            available_skills=self.available,
            messages=messages,
            model_runner=unavailable,
        )

        self.assertEqual(result["decision"], "chat")
        self.assertNotEqual(result.get("skill"), "wb-work")

    def test_explicit_execution_confirms_pending_write_handoff(self) -> None:
        messages = [
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": "等待确认",
                "routing": {
                    "decision": "chat",
                    "skill": "wb-chat",
                    "pending_handoff": {
                        "skill": "wb-work",
                        "mode": "implement",
                        "workflow": None,
                        "gate": "explicit-request",
                        "reason": "等待执行授权",
                    },
                },
            }
        ]

        result = route_semantically(
            "按照这个来落地",
            self.config,
            project_id="shuheng",
            available_skills=self.available,
            messages=messages,
        )

        self.assertEqual(result["decision"], "direct")
        self.assertEqual(result["skill"], "wb-work")
        self.assertEqual(result["match_type"], "semantic-pending-handoff")

    def test_model_route_below_margin_becomes_pending_clarification(self) -> None:
        def runner(prompt: str, stage: str, timeout: int) -> str:
            del prompt, stage, timeout
            return self._route_result(
                "wb-repo",
                score=0.90,
                alternative_skill="wb-work",
                alternative_score=0.80,
                mode="diagnose",
            )

        result = route_semantically(
            "帮我处理一下这个项目的问题",
            self.config,
            project_id="shuheng",
            available_skills=self.available,
            model_runner=runner,
        )

        self.assertEqual(result["decision"], "chat")
        self.assertEqual(result["mode"], "clarify")
        self.assertEqual(result["pending_handoff"]["skill"], "wb-repo")
        self.assertLess(result["margin"], self.config["_semantic_routing"]["minimum_margin"])

    def test_high_risk_owner_requires_current_input_evidence(self) -> None:
        def runner(prompt: str, stage: str, timeout: int) -> str:
            del prompt, stage, timeout
            return self._route_result("wb-git", alternative_skill="wb-repo")

        result = route_semantically(
            "帮我处理一下仓库",
            self.config,
            project_id="shuheng",
            available_skills=self.available,
            model_runner=runner,
        )

        self.assertEqual(result["decision"], "chat")
        self.assertEqual(result["pending_handoff"]["skill"], "wb-git")
        self.assertEqual(result["pending_handoff"]["gate"], "explicit-request")

    def test_model_failure_safely_falls_back_to_chat(self) -> None:
        def runner(prompt: str, stage: str, timeout: int) -> str:
            del prompt, stage, timeout
            raise SemanticRoutingError("invalid")

        result = route_semantically(
            "帮我处理一个不明确的任务",
            self.config,
            project_id="shuheng",
            available_skills=self.available,
            model_runner=runner,
        )

        self.assertEqual(result["decision"], "chat")
        self.assertEqual(result["match_type"], "semantic-model-fallback")

    def test_prompt_uses_dynamic_skills_bounded_tasks_and_redaction(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
            history_root = Path(temp_dir)
            today = datetime.now().astimezone().date().isoformat()
            record_dir = history_root / "shuheng" / today
            record_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
            (record_dir / "task-test.json").write_text(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "task_id": "task-test",
                        "project_id": "shuheng",
                        "title": "路由任务",
                        "goal": "验证上下文",
                        "expectation": {
                            "summary": "路由上下文包含结构化任务结果",
                            "source": "explicit",
                            "assessment": {
                                "status": "met",
                                "summary": "已满足",
                            },
                        },
                        "routing_trace": {
                            "status": "recorded",
                            "entries": [
                                {
                                    "router_source": "cx-adv",
                                    "match_type": "semantic-model",
                                }
                            ],
                            "final_owner": {
                                "skill": "wb-work",
                            },
                        },
                        "updated_at": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),
                        "agent_assessment": {
                            "status": "success",
                            "summary": "完成",
                        },
                        "execution_result": {"summary": "已验证"},
                        "user_feedback": {
                            "status": "received",

                            "routing_quality": "correct",
                        },
                        "learning_signal": {
                            "needs_review": False,
                            "reasons": [],
                        },
                        "original_inputs": [
                            {"content": "DO_NOT_COPY_TASK_ORIGINAL"}
                        ],
                    },
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                ),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            context = build_route_context(
                text="检查 api_key=sk-12345678901234567890 的配置",

        self.assertIn('"name": "wb-repo"', prompt)
